newsitem.title: USA: New York City seen selling $850 mln bonds Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: New York City seen selling $850 mln bonds Jan 14.

text.p: New York City is scheduled to sell as much as $850 million of debt Jan 14, an industry source said Friday.
The municipal market is keenly anticipating the sale because supplies of new bonds have dried up over the Christmas and New Year holidays.
"(They) are tentatively planning to be in the market on Jan 14," said the source, who declined to be named.

A city official in mid-December said New York City, one of the largest issuers in the municipal market, planned to sell approximately $775 million of tax-exempt and taxable debt sometime during that week in January.
The city's offering will include the sale of floating rate, taxable debt for European investors, an offering that still is expected to total about $300 million.
The city previously has offered its debt to European investors, but the upcoming issue will be the first floater.
The debt might be sold in Europe during the morning of Jan 14, before U.S. debt markets open, the industry source said.
